items.text: Ladd McConkey (ribs/chest) day-to-day after exiting Week 1; Harbaugh monitoring. Tre Harris primary beneficiary.
items.why: Left early Week 1; imaging/day-to-day per reports.
items.implication: If out, Harris/Davis upside in Chargers offense.

items.text: Brock Bowers (left knee meniscus trim) has legit chance to return Week 2 or 3 per coach. Same knee as prior PCL/bone bruise; scary history.
items.why: Coach Kubiak day-to-day; Schefter realistic Week 2 chance after trim.
items.implication: Monitor practice; Mayer benefits if out, reverse if active.

items.text: Zay Flowers hamstring not serious, day-to-day (playoff-level he'd return); MRI. Ja'Kobi Lane wrist fracture multi-week. Bateman/Moore beneficiaries.
items.why: Left early but not serious per Rapoport; Lane fractured wrist.
items.implication: Flowers likely plays; Lane out elevates Bateman.

items.text: Patriots placing A.J. Brown on IR with high-ankle sprain; out minimum 4 games (earliest Week 6).
items.why: MRI confirmed high ankle; Schefter/Rapoport reports.

items.text: Browns place RB Dylan Sampson on IR (knee); sign Jaleel McLaughlin. Sanders saw routes in Week 1.
items.why: Knee injury early Week 1; IR move.
items.implication: Judkins lead but committee with Sanders/McLaughlin.

items.text: Week 2 waivers: McConkey=Tre Harris; Lane=Bateman; Kamara=Miller; Sampson=Sanders; Brown beneficiaries Doubs/Douglas. Stream Wentz etc.
items.why: Precise injury beneficiary list and FAAB/streamers.

items.text: Rashee Rice career aDOT 4.9, only 2.5 last night with 2 targets (7% share). Routes solid: 29 of 33 Mahomes dropbacks (behind only Worthy 30). Needs volume to produce.
items.why: High route share but tiny aDOT and low target share in debut.
items.implication: Volume-dependent; monitor for target increase or remain boom-bust.
items.opportunity: Routes present but aDOT/target share low

items.text: Kenneth Walker handled 29 of first 32 RB opportunities in KC debut, 19 routes on 33 dropbacks, 6 targets (22% share), finishing 23-173-1 rush + 3-18-1 rec. True workhorse role as expected.
items.why: Dominated early opportunities and routes/targets in Mahomes offense.
items.implication: High-end RB1/RB2 with elite volume and receiving work.
items.opportunity: Workhorse snaps, routes, targets, goal-line implied

items.text: Ashton Jeanty 73% snaps, 70% rushes, 61% routes, 21% targets, 23-156-2 total in Week 1; upgrades to high-end RB1 every-down role.
items.why: Utilization Score 99 tying Bijan; improved YAC/YBC behind better OL.
items.implication: Lock high-end RB1 ROS with Kubiak scheme.

items.text: Travis Etienne 58% snaps but only 43% attempts, 38% routes in committee even with Kamara out; downgrades to low-end RB2.
items.why: Three-way split despite Kamara absence; low route share.
items.implication: Committee risk persists; Kamara return further dilutes.

items.text: Deebo Samuel is a Week 2 waiver wire target.
items.why: Highlighted on FF Happy Hour as add.

items.text: Bucky Irving 62% snaps, 58% routes, 53% rushes, stayed in LDD; upgrades mid-range RB2 over Gainwell.
items.why: Clear lead despite Gainwell addition; high utilization score 85.

items.text: Quinshon Judkins only 13 routes on 30 Watson dropbacks; even after Sampson (knee) early exit, Browns used Sanders for 13 routes.
items.why: Low pass-game involvement despite injury to backup.

items.text: Isiah Pacheco surgery to remove body pressing nerve in back; 12-week recovery, possible early December return.
items.why: Originally MCL then back; surgery confirmed.
items.implication: Long-term out; KC RB depth impacted (Walker already there).
